title: Nepotism
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael returns to the office after a challenging summer and reveals he has hired his nephew Luke, sparking debates about nepotism among the staff. Luke's poor work performance and misconduct create tension, leading to confrontations and disciplinary actions, including a controversial spanking by Michael. Meanwhile, office dynamics are further complicated by pranks and evolving relationships, such as Gabe and Erin's new romance and Andy's frustrations. The episode explores themes of family loyalty, workplace fairness, and the consequences of favoritism.

main_threads.thread: Michael hires his nephew Luke, leading to office conflict over nepotism and Luke's poor work performance.

evidence.snippet: Michael: And another thing I did this summer, I hired my nephew.
Michael: No. No, Toby. He's not. Yes he is. He's my nephew.
Oscar: Michael, that's nepotism. Luke is getting special treatment because he's your nephew.
Angela: I came down here to feed the feral cats like I usually do and I found something unsavory in the back of your nephew's car.
Phyllis: Well, take a look. It's all the packages he was supposed to overnight. He never bothered to send them.
Jo: If you keep him, Michael, I'm gonna hold you accountable for him.

main_threads.thread: Michael defends Luke despite his shortcomings, resulting in disciplinary actions including a physical spanking and potential termination.

evidence.snippet: Michael: God, when he needed help on Earth, who did he hire? Jesus Christ, his son.

Gabe: Legal says the best way to protect us from a lawsuit is to call this a stress-induced outburst.
Gabe: The alternative is termination.
